title: Project Engineering and Facilities Manager
description:
Project Engineering and Facilities Manager Are you an experienced engineering and facilities leader who enjoys turning complex operational needs into practical, effective solutions? As Clarke's Project Engineering and Facilities Manager , you'll lead engineering activities and oversee our Illinois facilities, ensuring our buildings, equipment, and infrastructure support safe, efficient, and reliable operations. Key Responsibilities Develop and oversee engineering and facilities operating and capital budgets, evaluate project costs and proposals, identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities, and own the 3–5-year capital investment plan. Direct engineering initiatives that support equipment reliability, production improvements, facility modifications, and operational needs. Manage the maintenance and improvement of Clarke's Illinois facilities, grounds, utilities, and building systems. Plan and execute facility modifications, equipment installations, and capital improvement projects from scope development through completion. Lead predictive and corrective maintenance efforts for manufacturing equipment and partner with Operations, Quality, and EHS to improve equipment reliability, safety, and overall performance. Serve as the primary contact for external facilities vendors and contractors used in the plant. Ensure compliance with company requirements and applicable health, safety, environmental, building, fire, accessibility, and security regulations. Supervise, coach, and develop the Facilities Coordinator while building strong relationships with employees, contractors, vendors, and cross-functional partners. Hours: Monday - Friday, 8am – 5pm Location: Roselle, IL Candidates should be located in reasonable proximity to Roselle, IL. Relocation assistance will not be provided. Top Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. Five or more years of supervisory experience and facility management experience required. Ten or more years of project management experience required. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Project. Excellent equipment and maintenance knowledge. Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Strong internal customer service skills, including active listening, responsiveness, expectation setting, and consistent follow-up. Demonstrated ability to lead maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment and coordinate troubleshooting, repair, and reliability improvement efforts. Ability to partner cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, EHS, Engineering, contractors, and equipment suppliers to implement practical process improvements. Ability to read, write, and speak English required. This is an exempt salary position and the hiring range for this position is expected to be $130,000-$163,000. This range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The salary range offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, and certifications or other professional licenses held. BENEFITS We offer an outstanding compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401k (Roth and traditional) with a generous match, tuition reimbursement and career development and training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning subscriptions, paid parental leave program, electric vehicle incentives, paid volunteer time, generous PTO, paid holidays, paid winter break between Christmas and New Years, and discretionary bonus. ABOUT CLARKE Clarke is a global leader in environmentally responsible mosquito control. You'll join a team that cares about people, the planet, and meaningful work. ARE YOU READY? If you are excited about what you've read, please submit your resume and relevant information. Be sure to check out our website ( clarke.com ) to learn more about how Clarke is helping to make the world more livable, safe & comfortable. Clarke is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace.

Benefits
We offer an outstanding compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401k (Roth and traditional) with a generous match, tuition reimbursement and career development and training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning subscriptions, paid parental leave program, electric vehicle incentives, paid volunteer time, generous PTO, paid holidays, paid winter break between Christmas and New Years, and discretionary bonus.

Project Engineering and Facilities Manager

Are you an experienced engineering and facilities leader who enjoys turning complex operational needs into practical, effective solutions? As Clarke's Project Engineering and Facilities Manager, you'll lead engineering activities and oversee our Illinois facilities, ensuring our buildings, equipment, and infrastructure support safe, efficient, and reliable operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and oversee engineering and facilities operating and capital budgets, evaluate project costs and proposals, identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities, and own the 3–5-year capital investment plan.
  • Direct engineering initiatives that support equipment reliability, production improvements, facility modifications, and operational needs.
  • Manage the maintenance and improvement of Clarke's Illinois facilities, grounds, utilities, and building systems.

  • Serve as the primary contact for external facilities vendors and contractors used in the plant.
  • Ensure compliance with company requirements and applicable health, safety, environmental, building, fire, accessibility, and security regulations.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop the Facilities Coordinator while building strong relationships with employees, contractors, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

Hours: Monday - Friday, 8am – 5pm

Location: Roselle, IL

Candidates should be located in reasonable proximity to Roselle, IL. Relocation assistance will not be provided.

Top Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required.
  • Five or more years of supervisory experience and facility management experience required.
  • Ten or more years of project management experience required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Project.
  • Excellent equipment and maintenance knowledge.
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong internal customer service skills, including active listening, responsiveness, expectation setting, and consistent follow-up.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment and coordinate troubleshooting, repair, and reliability improvement efforts.
  • Ability to partner cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, EHS, Engineering, contractors, and equipment suppliers to implement practical process improvements.
  • Ability to read, write, and speak English required.

This is an exempt salary position and the hiring range for this position is expected to be $130,000-$163,000. This range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The salary range offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, and certifications or other professional licenses held.

BENEFITS

We offer an outstanding compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401k (Roth and traditional) with a generous match, tuition reimbursement and career development and training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning subscriptions, paid parental leave program, electric vehicle incentives, paid volunteer time, generous PTO, paid holidays, paid winter break between Christmas and New Years, and discretionary bonus.
